item.title: [7.0] Is Forgetting Unified? Exploring Concept Unlearning in Unified Multimodal Models
item.description:
WHAT HAPPENED

Unified multimodal models (UMMs) integrate image generation and visual understanding, but are existing single-pathway unlearning methods sufficient to suppress target concepts across both? In this work, we study cross-pathway concept unlearning. Our goal is to prevent a model from both generating images of a target concept and identifying it in input images, while preserving other capabilities.

WHY IT MATTERS

This paper addresses an emerging challenge in machine unlearning for unified multimodal models, introducing a new benchmark and method (UniForget) that moves beyond single-pathway limitations.
